title: Configuration cell index
statement: For a Boolean-input finite Turing machine $M$, natural numbers $N,T,t,r$, and an index $	au$ with $0\leq\tau<k$, define the cell index by $t$ times the configuration stride, plus $\tau(2T+1)+r$. Here the configuration stride is $k(2T+1)+N+3$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input
